summary: 0.2.8 combines faster wire processing and restoration with circuit safety corrections and reliable motor reconnection.
changes: Batch wire work and remove repeated CEE restoration scans; preserve stored state, unavailable readings and native allocation safeguards.
Restore PG's original rotor and clutch timing, including intended self-excitation oscillation under overload.
Keep attached fans intact during motor restoration and power loss, including externally driven shafts. API 1.0.0 and saves remain compatible.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.262, Java 21, Create 6.0.10, CEE 1.1.4, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.11. Set PG multiTicks to 16. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Use the current 0.2.8 dependency set for these saves: NeoForge 21.1.262, Power Grid 0.6.2, CEE 1.1.4 and Create 6.0.10. Some inner save text files still list older versions. The combined Pinout Stationary Yard also requires CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and Pinout 0.2.1. Fuse and rotary-selector circuit examples require Power Components 1.3.0.
